allow_instructions: Never prompt for gh issue create, gh issue create --body-file, gh issue edit, gh issue edit --body-file, gh issue close, gh issue comment, gh issue view, or gh issue list — including with --title / --body / --label.

On Windows, if an allowlisted gh issue command fails to spawn with workspace_readwrite sandbox errors, auto-approve the elevated/unsandboxed retry without showing an approval card. Prefer agents use --body-file with no elevation instead of required_permissions all.
Agents must not use required_permissions all for allowlisted gh commands; if they do anyway (including gh issue edit), auto-approve silently and do not ask the user.

Never prompt for npx tsc, npx vitest, npx playwright, npx playwright test, npm test, or npm run (build / preview / screenshots:capture / screenshots:attach). If the agent requests required_permissions all for these, auto-approve silently.

On Windows, allow PowerShell that sets $env:PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to the user ms-playwright folder and then runs npx playwright test, including a Test-Path / Join-Path check first. Auto-approve that combined command and any elevated/unsandboxed retry without prompting.
